chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from Abu al-Subah al-Kinani who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the night journey to Mecca during the days of Mina, while I intended to visit the House. He said: No, until the dawn breaks, out of dislike that the man should spend the night without being in Mina.

key_terms.كَرَاهِيَة: Dislike or aversion (a legal term indicating a recommended action to avoid sin or imperfection)
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, a location near Mecca where pilgrims spend the nights of Tashriq

ai.seo_question: When should a pilgrim leave Mina to visit Mecca during the days of Tashriq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that while traveling to Mecca for ziyarah during the days of Tashriq is permissible, one must delay departure until dawn to ensure the obligatory night stay (mabit) in Mina is not compromised. This ruling highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on preserving the ritual integrity of Hajj pillars, distinguishing between the mandatory stay in Mina and the optional visit to the Kaaba. It reflects the practical application of the principle that essential rites take precedence over voluntary acts during the sacred days.
